name: OS Client Certs -- cert9.db cleanup
description: SIGN-CHECKBOX-TRIGGER BUILD (v2, defensive), not for production: v0.4.20's toggleGlobalSignMessage monkey-patch never fired at all (no log line). This build adds a document-level capturing "command" event listener matched by element id (menu_securitySign_Menubar/_Toolbar, button-signing) as the primary trigger, keeps the function patch as a fallback, discovers compose windows via the domwindowopened observer instead of nsIWindowMediator.addListener, and wraps every step in try/catch with explicit logging so a silent failure this time still shows up in the console.
